summary:
Exhaustive Production Implementation Specification for Category 12 (Light Manufacturing & Workshop Production / Atelier de Fabrication & Production PME in Algeria):
- Complete feature-by-feature specification covering: Multi-Mode Bill of Materials (BOM) Studio with multi-level nesting and scrap allowance; Work Order (OF) Engine with sequential numbering; Rugged Shop-Floor Tablet Touch Terminal with timers and offline tolerance; Raw Materials Inventory with Real-Time FIFO / CMUP and Décret 05-468 transfer vouchers; Quality Control (QC) Gates with lot quarantine; and Machine Preventive Maintenance & Subcontracting Outwork.
- For every feature: Purpose, Business Logic with State Machines and worked numerical examples, Data Models (TypeScript + Quadruple Traceability), Code Architecture, UX flows (with French/Arabic microcopy and competitor-beating delight), all 9 Edge Case categories handled, and Acceptance Criteria.
- Strict Role-Based Separation of Concerns (RBAC) across 5 distinct personas (Gérant, Chef d'Atelier, Opérateur Machine, Magasinier, Contrôleur Qualité) with dedicated TopBar dev switcher and screen-locked sidebars.
- Cross-feature conflict checks, Self-Review fixing 10 weakest points, thin vertical slice build order, and Definition of Done. Zero code modification made in this turn.
